# Color profiles
CMYK demo profile: ISOcoated_v2_300_mth.icc by Pascal de Bruijn / Amethyst.
Source https://github.com/pmjdebruijn/amethyst-cmyk-icc-profiles/tree/5a36861414d0b634d6f7a1d34ffa4dd2a895a92e
CC0-1.0; see CMYK-LICENSE.txt. This is an experimental profile as described by its author; import the print shop ICC profile for production separations.
Luma works in sRGB and uses LittleCMS for profile-based separation and round-trip proofing.
